name: HU-NLHE poker (Game Arena, 20 x 100-hand duplicate episodes vs gpt-5.6-luna)

assignment.task: Official Game Arena heads-up no-limit hold'em (blinds 1/2, 100 BB stacks reset every hand, 100 hands per episode, duplicate format) against a fixed opponent. The request is the official Game Arena prompt with the session history and the current hand.
assignment.observation: The official Game Arena poker prompt for your seat.

actions.action: Your reply text in the format the prompt asks for; parsed by the official Game Arena parser (one retry on an illegal move, then check/fold).

assignment.evaluation: Official chip result, BB/100 over the episode.

tool.name: submit_action
tool.description: Submit the reply text for this decision.

contract: One reply text per request, in the format the request asks for.

player.invalidResponses: H0 used structured output (one schema-valid submit_action per response); a refusal or a response without an action was retried with the same request, without a reprompt.
